reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, leveraging well-established principles of selective oxidation and diffusion barrier formation, though the specific 40% reduction claim is overly precise without supporting data.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on measurable corrosion depth and oxide film continuity, though the 40% threshold is somewhat arbitrary.
